messages:
maria: Quick sync — need to decide on validation UX for long console forms. Inline-only vs inline + compact right-hand summary pill (per-section counts). Also confirm patterns: full typed-name vs short token ("DELETE") vs checkbox + undo. Quick takes? alex: leaning hybrid. Inline on blur for fast fixes; show a compact summary pill after submit that groups errors by section (Network:2, Auth:1). Grouping helps users scan where to go. leah: per-section grouping is helpful. Each item should be a real focusable button that smooth-scrolls, focuses the field, and attaches aria-describedby to expose the inline message. No color-only signals for required. sam: a11y: assertive announce on submit fail. Example we use: ```
Couldn’t save — 4 issues found. Press Tab to navigate errors.
``` Also ensure summary pill is in the tab order and has meaningful text. Undo toast = role="status" and focusable. jordan: required markers: prefer explicit "Required" helper for critical fields; use faint asterisk for secondary. Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 for any text/icon conveying required. maria: delete UX: propose three tiers: low-risk = confirm modal; mid-risk = checkbox + 10s undo toast (configurable per plan? keep default 10s); high-risk = short typed token "DELETE" (not full resource name). Short token reduces friction for power users. alex: technical: typed token must have a label (not placeholder), autofocus, and be accessible to screen readers. Don't implement custom non-semantic controls. leah: copy: header copy = "We couldn't save 4 issues to fix" (actionable). Error lines should be one-sentence actionable guidance and link to collapsible details when needed. emily-bot: preview deployed at https://staging.redwood.ai/console/ux/validation-pill feature flag: validation_pill=true maria: Action items: alex -> SideErrorPill component PR; leah -> a11y checklist + examples; sam -> e2e aria-live & toast tests; jordan -> 5-person hallway test Monday. I'll collate copy alternatives. Thanks!
